title: interview.session_interrupted.v1
description: A session stopped without completing and may resume. Emitted for every interruption including recoverable ones, because the pattern across many sessions is what tells operations a provider is degrading, and that pattern is invisible if only the fatal ones are reported.

reason.description: What broke. A closed set so that a consumer can act on it, since prose here would be something only a human could read.

resumable.description: Whether the session may continue. A screening session's answer is a policy decision recorded elsewhere, not one a consumer should infer from the reason.

attempt.description: Which interruption this is for the session. Repeated interruption is the operational signal, not any single one.
